info.name: QR Card Dating App API - Complete Flow
info.description:
🎯 **Complete User Flow**: Users register → Admin approves → User sets password → User logs in → Full access!

**Key Features:**
✅ User registration with email verification
✅ Admin-controlled approval system
✅ Password-based user authentication (NEW!)
✅ JWT token-based access control (NEW!)
✅ Admin-only QR code generation
✅ Automatic email notifications
✅ Complete user journey testing
✅ Enhanced security and validation

**📋 User Authentication Flow (NEW!):**
1. User registers: `POST /auth/register`
2. Admin approves: `POST /admin/users/{id}/approve`
3. User receives password setup email
4. User sets password: `POST /auth/set-password`
5. User logs in: `POST /auth/user/login`
6. User gets JWT token for protected endpoints

**🔐 User Endpoints (NEW!):**
• Set Password: `POST /auth/set-password`
• Reset Password: `POST /auth/reset-password/:email`
• User Login: `POST /auth/user/login`
• Returns JWT access token

**👨‍💼 Admin Endpoints:**
• Admin Login: `POST /auth/admin/login`
• Admin Forgot Password: `POST /auth/admin/forgot-password`
• Admin Reset Password: `POST /auth/admin/reset-password`
• QR Generation: `POST /qr-cards/generate/by-email` (⚠️ ADMIN ONLY)
• Pending Users: `GET /admin/users/pending`
• Approve User: `POST /admin/users/approve`
• Reject User: `POST /admin/users/reject`

**🔐 Authentication Required For:**
• QR Code Generation (Admin token)
• Admin Dashboard & Management (Admin token)
• User-specific operations (User token - NEW!)

**🚀 Quick Start:** Run 'Complete User Journey' folder to test the full flow.

**📅 Last Updated:** November 18, 2025
**🔧 Version:** 3.0 - User Authentication & Password Reset

request.description:
🔐 **Set User Password**

After admin approves registration, users receive an email with a password setup link. This endpoint allows users to set their password.

**📝 Requirements:**
• User must be VERIFIED or ACTIVE status
• Valid email address
• Password (no specific requirements currently)

**✅ After Setting Password:**
• User status changes to ACTIVE
• User can login via POST /auth/user/login
• Password is securely hashed with bcrypt

**📧 When Does User Get This Link?**
Automatically sent when admin approves registration via:
• Admin dashboard approval
• POST /admin/users/approve

**🔗 Frontend URL:**
`https://scanmemaybe.com/auth/reset-password/{email}`

🔓 **User Login**

Authenticate user with email and password to receive JWT access token.

**📝 Requirements:**
• User must have set password first
• Valid email and password combination

**✅ Response Includes:**
• JWT access token (valid for 7 days)
• User details (id, email, name, status)
• Profile information (if exists)

**🔐 Use Access Token For:**
• Accessing protected user endpoints
• Managing user's own data
• QR card management

**💡 Token Usage:**
Add to request headers:
`Authorization: Bearer {access_token}`

request.description:
🔑 **Reset Password by Email (Alternative Endpoint)**

This endpoint accepts email as a URL parameter, useful for password reset links.

**📧 Email Link Format:**
`https://scanmemaybe.com/auth/reset-password/{email}`

**📝 How It Works:**
1. User clicks link from email
2. Frontend extracts email from URL
3. User enters new password
4. Frontend calls this endpoint

**⚖️ Difference from /auth/set-password:**
• This uses email in URL path
• /auth/set-password uses email in body only
• Both do the same thing internally
• Use whichever fits your frontend architecture

🎨 **Complete HTML/CSS Customization Example**

This demonstrates the full power of the new HTML template system:

**🎯 What Admins Can Customize:**
• **Colors & Gradients** - Background colors, button colors, text colors
• **Fonts & Typography** - Font families, sizes, weights, spacing
• **Layout & Spacing** - Padding, margins, grid layouts
• **Animations** - CSS animations and transitions
• **Responsive Design** - Mobile-friendly layouts
• **Branding Elements** - Logos, social links, custom styling

**🔥 Advanced Features:**
• Gradient backgrounds with animation
• Glass-morphism effects (backdrop-filter)
• Custom box shadows and hover effects
• Grid layouts for feature cards
• SVG backgrounds and patterns
• Social media integration
• Fully responsive design

**📝 Template Variables:**
• `{{userName}}` - User's name
• `{{subject}}` - Email subject
• `{{body}}` - Email body text
• `{{currentYear}}` - Current year
• `{{dashboardUrl}}` - Link to dashboard

**💡 Pro Tips:**
• Use inline CSS for maximum email client compatibility
• Test with different email clients
• Keep fallback colors for gradient support
• Use web-safe fonts as fallbacks

This gives admins complete control over email appearance while maintaining professional email standards!"
